newsitem.title: USA: Oncogene president resigns to join NuGene.
newsitem.headline: Oncogene president resigns to join NuGene.

text.p: Oncogene Science Inc said on Monday that its president, Steve Peltzman, resigned to join NuGene Technologies Inc as president and chief executive.
Oncogene is an investor in the privately held NuGene, which will be based in Cambridge, Mass., Oncogene said in a news release.

Oncogene said Peltzman will remain on its board of directors. His duties as president will be assumed by Oncogene's chief executive, Gary Frashier; by Dr. Colin Goddard, its chief operating officer; and by Dr. Arthur Bruskin, senior vice president for drug discovery.
Oncogene is a pharmaceutical discovery company.
